precision: float32 master weights; CUDA bfloat16 autocast
training_scope: official default: freeze VLM; update all 16 action expert layers, state and action interfaces; plus goal_embedding (Expert side) and goal_planner (separate group)
schedule_source: fine-tune from baseline A step 10000 (fresh AdamW): warmup 200, cosine 5e-5 -> 2.5e-6 over 5000 steps; micro-batch 16 x 4 = effective 64 on the local 8 GB RTX 4060
task: Pick up the red cube and place it on the blue circle.
data_scope: goal-conditioned structure (experiment B modules) on exactly the DAgger round 1 data: v2 training frames (recorded expert goals) plus the same DAgger samples, whose goal labels are the phase/goal pose of the takeover expert that produced their chunk; DAgger rows listed 4 times; init from baseline A step 10000 with zero-initialised goal modules (identical start to DAgger round 1); stats of v2; offline check on v2 validation episodes x 3 frames; test seeds unused

goal_conditioning.goal_vector: phase one-hot 9, delta position / 0.1 m 3, R_tcp^T R_goal 6D 6, phase aperture / 100 1, |delta| / 0.1 m 1; world frame = robot base frame
goal_conditioning.injection: zero-initialised MLP added to all 50 Expert action tokens; prefix, suffix length, masks and position ids unchanged
